tasks.task: I need an NSFW-inclusive snapshot search for username "matthewc" for today’s compliance review, but only if our API key is entitled to include NSFW sites. Create (or reuse) the run using fingerprint "ops-snapshot-2026-08-05-matthewc-nsfw", then confirm the stored run is in succeeded status and report the counts (sites_checked, matches_found) before I export the results by end of day.

success_criteria: Step 1 returns entitlements.include_nsfw_allowed = true and api_key.status = "active".
Step 3 returns a list with at least one run whose request_fingerprint = "ops-snapshot-2026-08-05-matthewc-nsfw" and username = "matthewc".
Step 4 returns data.id equal to $2.data.0.id and include_nsfw = true.
Step 4 returns status = "succeeded" with non-negative integer sites_checked and matches_found fields that can be reported.
